description.zh: 宽松模式泳道组的基线泳道名称。仅在泳道组为宽松模式时，设置此参数有效。
description.en: The name of the baseline swim lane for the group. This parameter is used only if the group operates in loose mode.
The name of the swim lane group.

description.zh:
为泳道组内的多个泳道进行请求引流的策略，有两种可能取值：
* weighted：基于权重的引流策略，即首先以统一的规则对请求进行匹配，对匹配到的请求进行引流，引流时，按照给定的比例将所有请求发往不同的泳道。
* rule-based：基于规则的引流策略，即泳道组中的每条泳道都拥有自己的匹配规则，只有匹配到泳道对应的引流规则的请求才会被转发到对应的泳道。
description.en:
The policy for routing requests to the swim lanes in the group. Valid values:

- `weighted`: Specifies a weight-based routing policy. Requests that match a single, group-wide routing rule are routed to different swim lanes based on specified weights.

- `rule-based`: Specifies a rule-based routing policy. Each swim lane has its own routing rule. A request is forwarded to a swim lane only if it matches that swim lane's routing rule.
This parameter is not in use.
The ID of the Service Mesh instance.

description.zh: 泳道组关联的服务列表。
description.en: The list of services associated with the swim lane group.

description.zh: 当泳道组的引流策略为weighted时可以设定。作用于整个泳道组的引流规则，
description.en: The routing rule for the entire swim lane group. This parameter is used when the group's routing policy is `weighted`.

descriptions.zh: 调用DescribeASMSidecarExpectedVersion可以查询ASM数据面Sidecar的期望版本，例如升级ASM之前，注入Sidecar的版本为v1.11，然后升级ASM到v1.12，Pod没有重启，Sidecar的实际版本仍然为v1.11，但是调用DescribeASMSidecarExpectedVersion这个接口将查询到Sidecar版本是v1.12。
descriptions.en: Call the DescribeASMSidecarExpectedVersion API to query the expected version of a sidecar proxy on the Service Mesh (ASM) data plane. For example, after an ASM instance is upgraded to v1.12, the actual version of a v1.11 sidecar proxy remains v1.11 until its pod is restarted. However, a call to the DescribeASMSidecarExpectedVersion API returns the new expected version, v1.12.
